title: Points currency and transfer rules
description: One points currency (Chase Ultimate Rewards, Amex Membership Rewards, Capital One, Citi ThankYou, Bilt, Wells Fargo Rewards) with its transfer partners and quirks. Source: docs/transfer-matrix.md. Draft.

cashBackRedemption.description: Whether cash back is a reasonable redemption. Amex MR is 'poor' unless the player holds one of the special cards described in the transfer matrix.

householdPooling.description: True if points can be moved between household members (Chase UR, Capital One). Governs whether another player's unlocking card counts.

unlockerCards.description: Holding any of these unlocks transfers to partners. Empty if the currency has no unlocker.

cashBackQualifiers.description: For a currency whose cash-out is 'poor': combinations that make it a good cash back redemption for a player. Each needs every listed card held now (in the player's own name), plus the named account if any. A card that is itself listed qualifies for its own bonus, except that an account requirement must already be met.
